item.title: Ironside Fish & Oyster San Diego - Fresh seafood with Korean palate
item.description: A Korean traveler's honest review of Ironside Fish & Oyster in San Diego's Little Italy. Octopus a la plancha and chopped tuna toast hit the spot. Pricey but worth it for the vibe.
